name: Chaaktil
description: Chaaktil was a desert planet located in the Chaaktil system in the Inner Rim, in grid square N-14 on the Standard Galactic Grid. It had many cities, such as Chaako City. The bounty hunter Bazine Netal grew up on Chaaktil, where she learned a range of deadly martial arts at Delphi Kloda's combat school. Chaaktil was also the homeworld of Vi Moradi.
